image1.jpeg.title: Turtle in a Flower Storm
image1.jpeg.description: A wide-eyed turtle with a mouthful of teeth drifts through a sky of blooming watercolor blossoms, while a grey giant wades in from the right. Watercolor and marker.

image2.jpeg.title: A Thousand Faces
image2.jpeg.description: A whole universe on one page: crocodiles, skeletons, suns and dozens of grinning heads packed edge to edge, with secret words hidden in the crowd. Ink and watercolor.

image4.jpeg.title: The Big Grin
image4.jpeg.description: Drawn almost in one breath: two lashed eyes, a heart-shaped nose in red and blue, and an enormous jagged smile, with a long squiggle winding through the belly. Marker on paper.

image5.jpeg.title: Spiral Eyes
image5.jpeg.description: A quiet oval face in the style of a dream: one red spiral eye, one blue, and a softly striped mouth glowing in patches of yellow and earth-brown watercolor.

image6.jpeg.title: Inside and Outside
image6.jpeg.description: A double portrait: on one side a pink-eyed face in a checkered sweater, on the other its skeleton, ribs and bones laid out in orange and pink on a field of yellow. An X-ray in crayon.

image7.jpeg.title: The Smiling Planet
image7.jpeg.description: A golden ring orbited by stones of orange, grey and black, with a tiny face peeking out from the middle next to a single hand-drawn star. Pure watercolor.

image9.jpeg.title: Sugar Skull in a Red Hat
image9.jpeg.description: A proud skull in profile with blue scribble curls, teardrop eyes and a great grid of teeth, wrapped in a hot-pink and red headdress. Crayon and marker, full of energy.

image10.jpeg.title: The Box That Fell From the Sky
image10.jpeg.description: Under an orange sky, a great patterned cube tumbles down among laughing skulls, a blue-toothed egg, and a small hero on a white banner. Watercolor, pencil and marker.

image11.jpeg.title: Frog With a Jeweled Belly
image11.jpeg.description: An enormous orange frog opens wide to show a radiating fan of green, gold and red in its middle, while a small winged figure looks on. Marker and watercolor.

image13.jpeg.title: Skull With Orange Wings
image13.jpeg.description: A gentle skull with deep ringed eyes dotted in red, a sideways mouth of blue teeth, and great orange wings sweeping past, all on a wash of lemon yellow.

image14.jpeg.title: Green Head, Number Five
image14.jpeg.description: A round green head laughs a piano-key laugh in a storm of red and brown crayon, beside a huge charcoal 5, tiny flowers, and a little dog trotting up the hill.

image15.jpeg.title: Wire Ghost
image15.jpeg.description: The lightest piece in the collection: a face conjured from a few wandering lines of green, black, blue and red, with a grid smile and one raised wing. Pen on paper.
